list.title: Hagayaal
list.lead: Hagayaal luuqad fudud ah oo loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyeyaasha cusub: laga bilaabo waxa glaze yahay ilaa gubiddiisa, iyo sida qof walba loo ilaaliyo inta lagu jiro.
list.note: Hagayaashani waxay isku keenaan waxa ay daabacaan shirkadaha wax soo saara, hay'adaha badbaadada iyo dhoobo-sameeyeyaal khibrad leh, iyadoo ilaha lagu qoray dhammaadka mid kasta. Waa meel laga bilaabo, ma aha beddelka warqadaha xogta badbaadada (safety data sheets) ee walxahaaga, buugga tilmaamaha kiln-kaaga ama xeerarka deegaanka.

glazingBasics.title: Aasaaska glaze-ka
glazingBasics.text: Waxa glaze yahay, sida uu u dhalaalo, iyo eray kasta oo aad kula kulmi doonto hab ama joonyad, oo la sharxay.

makingAGlaze.title: Sida loo sameeyo glaze
makingAGlaze.text: Iibsashada, kaydinta, miisaamidda, isku-qasidda iyo shaandheynta glaze, kadibna tijaabintiisa iyo qorista diiwaanno.

safeMixing.title: Isku-darka ammaanka ah iyo hawo-wareejinta
safeMixing.text: Boodh, respirator-yo, nadiifin, walxaha u baahan daryeelka ugu badan, iyo hawo-ka-saarka kiln-ka.

homeSafety.title: Ha sumayn qoyskaaga
homeSafety.text: Dhoobo-samayn guriga oo ay joogaan carruur iyo xayawaan guri: kaydin, boodh, kiln-ka, iyo waxa la sameeyo haddii wax la liqo.

firing.title: Gubidda kiln fudud
firing.text: Cone-yo, kiln sitter-yo iyo furayaasha gacanta, oo leh jadwallo gubidda bisque iyo glaze.

learnWithJohnBritt.title: Ku baro koorsada glaze ee bilaashka ah ee John Britt
learnWithJohnBritt.text: Koorsadiisa muuqaalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee YouTube, cutub cutub, oo leh hagayaashayada la akhriyo iyo layliyo lagu tijaabiyo Glazecalc. Ingiriisi ku qoran.

teachingGlazeCalculation.title: Barashada xisaabta glaze
teachingGlazeCalculation.text: 6 casharro oo loogu talagalay fasal ama koox waxbarasho, laga bilaabo tile-yada triaxial ilaa UMF labada dhinac loo xalliyey, oo leh warqado shaqo oo la daabaco.

cones.title: Shaxda cone-yada
cones.text: Cone-yada Orton iyo SK oo leh heerkulkooda °C iyo °F, iyo meesha tiro kastaa ka timid.

materials.title: Walxaha caadiga ah
materials.text: Walax kasta oo maktabadda ku jirta oo leh falanqaynteeda oksaydh, waxa ay ku darsato unity formula-da iyo khatarteeda.

famous.title: Glaze caan ah
famous.text: Glaze adduunka oo dhan laga yaqaan, mid kasta oo laga sameeyey walxihiisa dhaqameed ee deegaanka, oo leh UMF-tiisa iyo nooc laga sameeyey walxaha laga iibiyo meesha aad joogto.

stull.title: Shaxda Stull: silica iyo alumina UMF-ta

regions.underfired: aan si ku filan loo gubin

stull.keyBright: Xariiq dhibcaha leh: meesha glaze-yada Stull ay ugu ifayeen.
stull.keyCrazed: Xariiqyo isdhaafsan: meesha ay crazing ku sameeyeen.
stull.note: Waa hage, ma aha saadaal. R. T. Stull (Transactions of the American Ceramic Society, 1912) wuxuu ku gubay qiyaastii cone 11 isagoo flux-yada ku dhejiyey 0.3 K₂O iyo 0.7 CaO; flux kale iyo gubid kale ayaa dhaqaajiya gobollada, oo glaze aan ifayn (matte) sababtoo ah keliya in aan si fiican loo gubin ayaa weli shaxda ku muuqan kara mid ifaya. Gobolladu waa sida Glazy u sawirto.
stull.inGuide: Silica (SiO₂) dhinac ahaan, qiyaastii 1 ilaa 7, iyo alumina (Al₂O₃) kor u kac, 0 ilaa 1, labaduba waxay ka yimaadeen UMF-ta. Qaybo qaab-gees ah ayaa bidix ka fidsan: kan aan dhalaalin kor bidix, kadibna aan ifayn, kadibna qayb ahaan aan ifayn. Qaybta aan hooska lahayn ee midigtooda ah way ifaysaa, xariiqda dhibcaha ah ee dhexdeeda ahna waa halka glaze-yada Stull ugu ifayeen. Kan aan si fiican loo gubin waa hoos midig, alumina yar iyo silica badan. Xariiqyada iskutallaabta ah, hoos shaxda iyo dhinaceeda bidix, waa halka tijaabooyinkiisu ay crazing ku yeesheen.
